data.name: Thumamah
data.long_meaning: Thumamah is an Arabic name for boys that means 'abundance', 'plenty'. It is derived from the TH-M-H root which is used in the Quran in Surat Al-Baqarah (2:258) where it is said that Allah is the one who provides sustenance in abundance.
data.numerology_meaning: Indicates a diplomatic and peaceful nature, and the ability to adapt to any situation.

in_arabic.name: ثمامہ

in_pashto.name: ثمامہ
in_pashto.meaning: ثمامہ د ډیرو وړاندې کولو معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ثمامہ یو عربي نوم دی چې د ډیرو وړاندې کولو معنی لري، دا نوم د پيغمبر اسلام صلی الله عليه وسلم په حديث کې راغلی دی، او په افغان او پښتني دود کې مهم دی

in_english.name: Thumamah
in_english.meaning: one who talks excessively or frequently
in_english.long_meaning: Thumamah is a masculine Arabic name that means 'one who talks excessively or frequently'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'th-m-m', which conveys the idea of speaking or talking. The name Thumamah is mentioned in Islamic tradition and history, particularly in reference to Thumamah ibn Athal al-Ansari, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name holds spiritual significance in Islamic culture and is used across various Muslim communities worldwide.
